verdict.rationale: GitHub publishes an extensive documented REST/GraphQL API with authentication and permission scoping (github-docs-18, github-docs-19), and this is corroborated by a discoverable llms.txt developer docs entrypoint (github-probe-1), an official CLI (github-probe-4), and an official MCP server (github-probe-3) showing programmatic/agentic access is well supported. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec at expected endpoints (github-probe-2 shows 404s) and independent hands-on confirmation of API robustness from AI-native users specifically.
